KEY FEATURES

What it does.

Converts your steps and workouts into points, and lets you compete with friends in private leagues.

01
Apple Health

Works with Apple Health — steps and workouts from any device that syncs to Apple Health.

02
Age-adjusted

Age-adjusted workout intensity targets so the system is fair at every fitness level.

03
Privacy-focused

Privacy-focused: only points are shared, never your health data.

04
Month by month

Track progress month by month. Earn Bronze, Silver, or Gold medals each month.

THE SCORING

How points work.

If you have both steps and a workout on the same day, only the activity with the highest points counts toward your total.

DAILY STEPS
7k steps3PTS
10k steps5PTS
12.5k+ steps8PTS
WORKOUTS · 30 MIN+
Avg HR ≥ (220−age) × 0.65PTS
Avg HR ≥ (220−age) × 0.78PTS
Points for workouts are based on heart rate intensity relative to your age. See the full breakdown in Setup.
MONTHLY MEDAL TARGETS · DEFAULTS
Bronze 120 PTS
Silver 140 PTS
Gold 160 PTS
Set your own monthly targets to earn bronze, silver and gold medals. Defaults shown; fully customisable in Settings.
PRIVATE LEAGUES

Compete with friends.

Create or join private leagues to compete against friends. The league is based on each participant's daily points, and you can compete to finish on the medal podium! Only your points are shared — not your health data.

Set up a league →

SEE IT IN ACTION

The app, screen by screen.

SETTINGSimages/settingsWithDelete.png
01 · SETTINGS

Set your points targets in settings (along with enabling workouts if desired).

02 · DAILY POINTS

Your health data is converted into daily points to track your fitness activities, medals are awarded based on your targets.

03 · MY MEDAL TABLE

Keep going next month to try and improve, track your achievements in the Medals tab.

04 · COMPETITION

Go to the Compete tab to invite friends to private competitions to see who can earn the most points.
